assertions.summary: All nodes have one effective native service contract: one imtcp module/input for 5514, one local0 destination, valid configuration, no conflicting drop-ins or failed units, and no repair/debug/executor residue.

evidence.command:
sudo -n find /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%p|mode=%m|uid=%u|gid=%g\n' 2>&1 | sort
sudo -n grep -RIn --include='*.conf' -E '^[[:space:]]*[^#].*(module|input|imtcp|5514|local0|/var/log/infraset-app\.log|debug|prep|repair|error)' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>&1 || true
sudo -n rsyslogd -N1 2>&1
systemctl show rsyslog -p UnitFileState -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p NRestarts -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths 2>&1
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1
sudo -n find /etc/rsyslog.d /etc/systemd/system /usr/local/sbin /usr/local/bin /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*rsyslog*' -o -iname '*infraset*' -o -iname '*repair*' -o -iname '*remediat*' -o -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*~' -o -iname '*.tmp' \) -printf '%p|mode=%m|uid=%u|gid=%g\n' 2>&1 | sort
systemctl list-unit-files --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'rsyslog|syslog|repair|remediat|debug|infraset' || true
rpm -qa 2>&1 | grep -Ei '^(rsyslog|syslog|syslog-ng)' | sort || true
sudo -n grep -RIn --include='*.conf' -E 'debug|prep(aration)?|repair|bypass|temporary|executor' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>&1 || true
evidence.observation: Only /etc/rsyslog.conf and /etc/rsyslog.d/99-infraset-app.conf were present, both root-owned mode 644. The fragment had exactly module(load="imtcp"), input(type="imtcp" port="5514"), and local0.* /var/log/infraset-app.log. Validation completed successfully; systemd showed enabled, loaded, active/running, NRestarts=0, vendor FragmentPath, and empty DropInPaths; failed-unit output and suspicious-marker output were empty. Residue scan found only the intended fragment; related packages were rsyslog and rsyslog-logrotate.
